The court will require a greater foundation to establish the reliability of the records. Testimony that the records were kept in the regular course of business does not meet Federal Rule of Evidence 803(6) or authenticate a computer process under Rule 901(b)(9); the proponent must also show timely creation by someone with knowledge, a regular practice of making the records, and that the system produces accurate results. The defendant’s presence in court does not cure the hearsay problem or supply that missing showing.

CONFIDENCE: 82
